summary.zh-Hans: 里斯本商业广场面向特茹河河口，也叫王宫广场。穿过奥古斯塔街凯旋门，可以从广场进入奥古斯塔街。
summary.en: Lisbon's Praça do Comércio, also called Terreiro do Paço, opens toward the Tagus estuary. The Rua Augusta arch links the square with Rua Augusta.

summary.zh-Hans: 里斯本海洋馆的常设展以“一个星球，一个海洋”为主题，设有中央水族箱和四种海洋栖息地展示。展览把不同水域的海洋生命联系在一起。
summary.en: The Lisbon Oceanarium's permanent exhibition, One Planet, One Ocean, features a central aquarium and four ocean habitats. It connects marine life from different waters through the idea of one global ocean.

summary.zh-Hans: 葡式蛋挞在酥皮中装入用牛奶、蛋和糖等制成的馅料，再烤至表面上色。在里斯本的咖啡馆和糕点店，可以搭配肉桂粉品尝。
summary.en: Pastel de nata has a flaky pastry shell filled with a milk, egg and sugar custard, baked until the top browns. Lisbon cafés and pastry shops may serve it with cinnamon to sprinkle over.

summary.zh-Hans: 布拉斯式鳕鱼把鳕鱼拆成细碎鱼肉，与细炸薯条、洋葱和炒蛋拌在一起。黑橄榄和欧芹可用来点缀。
summary.en: Bacalhau à Brás combines shredded salt cod, thin fried potato sticks, onion and scrambled egg. Black olives and parsley can finish the dish.
